prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one polished GitHub repository cover image, wide 2:1 landscape, ideally 1536 by 768. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the existing portfolio series' pearl-grey/icy-blue studio background, subtle cyan light ribbons, large clear ink-navy sans-serif title on the left, short legible Chinese subtitle underneath, tangible editorial illustration on the right. Do not copy its boxer, pose overlay or wording. Spacious and clean, refined soft lighting, recognizable subject, no watermark, no badges, no decorative metadata. Text safely inside generous margins, readable as a GitHub thumbnail.
Project: Zhixu / 知序, an enterprise document knowledge-base management and AI question-answering website. Users upload and manage documents, inspect parsed pieces, and ask questions whose answers link back to document sources.
Reference image 2 is the existing FRONTEND PROTOTYPE interface, used as a visual reference only, not proof of a live AI result or enterprise deployment. On the right, show a tasteful desktop application panel with the faithful white-and-lavender knowledge-library layout, its Zhixu mark, slim sidebar and document library cards. Do not reproduce or invent statistics, production metrics or actual factual answers. Tiny interface details should stay understated. In front of the panel, a restrained arrangement of pale document sheets and a small translucent answer bubble connected to two clearly visible source tabs suggests documents becoming traceable answers. A subtle lavender accent echoes the real UI. No human faces, no corporate secrets, no giant generic robot or AI brain.
Exact and ONLY large cover text on the left:
"Zhixu"
"Knowledge Hub"
"企业文档管理与 AI 问答"
Use this concrete Chinese software category rather than an abstract slogan.
note: 封面为设计插画。知序界面参考公开仓库的前端原型截图，不代表真实模型效果或生产部署验收。
